description: Aggregates the same deterministic capability x opportunity x intent scoring used by /ot/threat-score across the actors relevant to a sector+region, ranks them, and returns a DeepSeek-written executive summary (BLUF, ICD-203 language). Portfolio-level companion to /ot/threat-score — for vCISO agents and GRC/board-reporting automation. Price: $0.40 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

compliance_framework.description: Optional — framework to note qualitatively in the narrative e.g. NIST_CSF_2_0, IEC_62443_3_2

region.description: Target region e.g. GCC, KSA, UAE, Qatar, Europe

sector.description: Target sector e.g. energy, water, manufacturing

vendor_stack.description: Optional comma-separated vendor list e.g. 'Schneider Modicon,Siemens SIMATIC' — feeds each actor's capability score, same as /ot/threat-score
